verdict.rationale: Weaviate documents its own backup feature, which can export an entire instance or selected collections to widely used blob storage (S3, GCS, Azure) and restore across providers. It is also open source and self-hostable, which eases leaving its cloud. The evidence never says backups use an open, portable format readable outside Weaviate, so the 'open formats and leave' part is unproven. Missing for 10: documented export in open/standard formats (e.g., JSON/Parquet) usable by other systems, an explicit bulk data-export tool beyond Weaviate-native backups, and independent corroboration of migrating off Weaviate.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Choice of backing up an entire instance, or selected collections only
Seamless integration with widely-used cloud blob storage, such as AWS S3, GCS, or Azure Storage
Backup and Restore between different storage providers
Weaviate is an open-source vector database (Go) that stores objects, vectors, and inverted indexes
